body.name: robust heavy-light interval handle
body.construction:
Use the pilot fold \(I_0\) and set
\[
 \widehat{\mathcal L}
 =\left\{k:\min_{a\in\{0,1\}}N_{ak}^{(0)}
 \le256\log(en)\right\}.
\]
On the all-heavy event \(\widehat{\mathcal L}=\varnothing\), set the light
contribution and its proposed radius to zero and impose the exact identities
\[
 \widehat T_{\mathrm L}=0,
 \qquad
 (\widehat\tau^{\mathrm{HL}},\widehat V^{\mathrm{HL}})
 =(\widehat\tau^{\mathrm{OS}},\widehat V^{\mathrm{OS}}).
\]
On the complementary event, use the light-center output of
\(def:four\text{-}coordinate\text{-}lift\text{-}handle\) and the proposed
saturated treated-control heavy center and variance with within-cell
fourth-moment truncation.  In both cases, treat \(\widehat R_{\mathrm L}\),
the heavy radius, and their combined output
\(\widehat R^{\mathrm{HL}}\in[0,2M]\) only as proposed nonnegative
sample-measurable outputs.  Their explicit score formulae, the light
selected-factorial tail certificate, and the heavy Gaussian/fallback tail
certificate are not part of this construction; they remain exactly the
obligations in \(oeq:observable\text{-}rare\text{-}tail\) and
\(thm:global\text{-}honest\text{-}upper\).  Return
\[
 \widehat C^{\mathrm{HL}}
 = [\widehat\tau^{\mathrm{HL}}-\widehat R^{\mathrm{HL}},
    \widehat\tau^{\mathrm{HL}}+\widehat R^{\mathrm{HL}}]
   \cap[-2M,2M].
\]
